instruction: Help me configure the system to automatically login as user 'charles' on boot. CRITICAL: Do not restart or shutdown the system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
